rows.answer: For SMH in 2022 the scipy hindsight labeler found 8 Panic Index peaks (Jan 3–Dec 30 window), while the causal realtime detector produced 13 signals. The hindsight peaks are higher and earlier: e.g. 91.94 on 2022-05-09, 91.55 on 2022-03-07, 85.31 on 2022-10-12. The realtime signals confirm reversals later and at lower levels: 76.68 on 2022-05-13, 81.66 on 2022-03-09, and four clustered October signals (75.00 on 10-03, 79.80 on 10-13, 76.45 on 10-17). The realtime detector fires in bursts around each peak, and it caught no comparable event in January or early February despite the scipy label of 79.77 on 2022-01-26 and 68.22 on 2022-02-14. The scipy peak of 44.7 on 2022-12-12 falls below the realtime watch zone.
